comparisons.scope: Head/full averaged over two seeds; shared 30-step horizon

protocol.display: Seed means at shared completed evaluation steps
protocol.head_feature: Advantage-weighted output-matrix gradient, two-sided 64 x 128 projection (GRADALIGN_PROD_SKETCH=1)
protocol.metric: Mean correctness over sampled responses; not pass@16
protocol.replay_rule: Last wall-time evaluation per step from the resumed run; all superseded values retained; never average replays as independent seeds
protocol.step_zero: Omitted: the available base measurement uses a different split
protocol.task: GradAlign Scenario 2, local Countdown instance draw

seed_averages.rule: Equal-weight arithmetic mean over distinct training seeds at shared completed steps; no interpolation
seed_averages.scope: LESSER: seeds 42, 43; Full policy gradient: seeds 42, 43; Dynamic sampling: seeds 42, 43; Random: seeds 42, 43

selection_shares.definition: Countdown share of the 256 problems selected at the start of each round; round r is selected at step 10r
